name: Ogre
notes: CR 2. Large. Greatclub +6 (2d8+4). Javelin +6 (2d6+4, 30/120 ft.). High HP (59). Treat as living battering ram vs. gate.
gm_notes: Session 2 raid, Phase 2. Used as a living battering ram against the west gate. Each round he is not stopped: gate takes 3d6+4 bludgeoning damage (gate HP 60, so ~3 rounds to breach). Can be targeted through arrow slits (ranged, 3/4 cover). Flanking via the east postern is the smart play. In melee he uses Greatclub; if the party pulls back, switches to Javelin. Does not have the intelligence to pursue fleeing enemies — he is pointed at the gate and that is his entire mission.
